title: Jakarta Running Festival 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Jakarta Running Festival 2026 Review | GBK, Jakarta
meta_description: Jakarta Running Festival review: 27,300 runners from 48 countries in October 2025, a marathon route past Monas and Kota Tua, and two World Athletics labels.
dek: Jakarta Running Festival grew by about 70% in a year, drawing 27,300 runners from 48 countries to Senayan in October 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: Jakarta Running Festival is a big and fast-growing running weekend. The 2025 edition, over 25 and 26 October at Istora Gelora Bung Karno, drew about 27,300 runners from 48 countries, around 70% more than the year before [1]. The marathon route ran through Sudirman-Thamrin, past Monas and into Kota Tua before returning to GBK, and the half marathon and marathon each earned a World Athletics label [1]. Kenyan runners won the open marathons and half marathons [1]. If you want a big-city festival marathon in Indonesia with a route through Jakarta's landmarks, this is a strong option.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: About 27,300 runners from 48 countries took part over 25 and 26 October 2025, based at Istora Gelora Bung Karno in Senayan [1]. That was an increase of about 70% on the year before [1].
The categories ran from 5 km and 10 km to the half marathon and full marathon [1]. Chip timing was used, and the half marathon and marathon received World Athletics labels [1].

sections.heading: A Route Through Jakarta
paragraphs: Each category's route was designed around city landmarks [1]. The marathon ran along Sudirman-Thamrin, past the National Monument (Monas) and into the old town, Kota Tua, before finishing back at GBK [1].
Around the races there were shakeout runs, fun runs and entertainment zones at the finish, drawing thousands of spectators and non-competitive participants [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Kenyan athletes dominated. Hitley Ombisi won the men's open marathon and Peris Jerono the women's, and Bernard Musau Wambua won the men's open half marathon [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large festival-style race in Jakarta with a marathon route past the city's landmarks and World Athletics labels on the longer races.
Plan for the scale. A field of more than 27,000 means crowded starts and a busy race village, so arrive early and know your corral.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
